registered_addition_groups.owner: M3-C-D candidate-only envelope and in-memory replay preflight
registered_addition_groups.rationale: All seven occurrences are bounded local construction inside an immutable in-memory preflight: canonical mapping UTF-8 encoding before SHA-256, copies updated to derive the next reducer snapshot, local receipt-list accumulation during ordered replay, and set comparisons for snapshot key/duplicate validation. The module imports no EventKernel/SQLite/file/network/thread/clock/production surface and performs no authoritative append, persistence write, action, scheduling, speech, legacy-domain authority transfer, or M3-E activation.

All eleven occurrences are test-local deterministic label hashing, local lifecycle-decision accumulation, intentional frozen/immutable assignment probes, and temporary AST import/call collection sets. They add no production mutation or capability and cannot append events, write persistence, integrate runtime, execute actions, schedule, speak, transfer legacy authority, or open M3-E.
